description: Interactive Collapsible Org Chart Visual v1.5.0 for Power BI using Deneb & Vega

signals.name: versionId
signals.description: Specification version identifier for tracking in Power BI projects

signals.name: defaultCollapseDepth
signals.description: Initial collapse level: 1 collapses managers at Level 1 and below (shows Level 0 and 1 on load). Set to 2 to show through Level 2, or 99 to expand all.

signals.name: gridThreshold
signals.description: Direct report threshold for multi-column grid stacking (teams with more reports than this arrange in 2 vertical columns)

signals.name: stackMinDepth
signals.description: Minimum hierarchy level depth where multi-column grid stacking is permitted (default: 2 prevents CEO / Level 1 executive team from stacking vertically)

signals.name: cardWidth
signals.description: Width of each employee card in pixels

signals.name: cardHeight
signals.description: Height of each employee card in pixels

signals.name: nodeSpacingX
signals.description: Horizontal distance between sibling node centers

signals.name: nodeSpacingY
signals.description: Vertical distance between hierarchy level centers (spacious corridor for clean branch routing)

signals.name: topMargin
signals.description: Top margin offset reserving space for the top control bar

signals.name: height
signals.update: treeExtentY ? max(minCanvasHeight, treeExtentY[1] + cardHeight + topMargin + 80) : minCanvasHeight

signals.name: expandAllOverride
signals.description: Global flag set to true when Expand All is clicked, false on Collapse All

signals.name: expandedIds
signals.description: Comma-delimited string of node IDs that were collapsed by default and explicitly expanded

on.update: datum.rawDepth >= defaultCollapseDepth ? (indexof(expandedIds, ',' + datum.id + ',') >= 0 ? replace(expandedIds, datum.id + ',', '') : expandedIds + datum.id + ',') : expandedIds

signals.name: collapsedIds
signals.description: Comma-delimited string of node IDs that were expanded by default and explicitly collapsed

on.update: datum.rawDepth < defaultCollapseDepth ? (indexof(collapsedIds, ',' + datum.id + ',') >= 0 ? replace(collapsedIds, datum.id + ',', '') : collapsedIds + datum.id + ',') : collapsedIds

transform.expr: isValid(datum['ParentID']) && datum['ParentID'] !== '' && datum['ParentID'] !== null && datum['ParentID'] !== '0' && datum['ParentID'] !== 0 && datum['ParentID'] != datum['ID'] ? toString(datum['ParentID']) : null

!expandAllOverride && ((isValid(datum.parentId) && ((datum.rawDepth - 1) >= defaultCollapseDepth ? indexof(expandedIds, ',' + datum.parentId + ',') < 0 : indexof(collapsedIds, ',' + datum.parentId + ',') >= 0)) || (isValid(datum.anc1) && ((datum.rawDepth - 2) >= defaultCollapseDepth ? indexof(expandedIds, ',' + datum.anc1 + ',') < 0 : indexof(collapsedIds, ',' + datum.anc1 + ',') >= 0)) || (isValid(datum.anc2) && ((datum.rawDepth - 3) >= defaultCollapseDepth ? indexof(expandedIds, ',' + datum.anc2 + ',') < 0 : indexof(collapsedIds, ',' + datum.anc2 + ',') >= 0)) || (isValid(datum.anc3) && ((datum.rawDepth - 4) >= defaultCollapseDepth ? indexof(expandedIds, ',' + datum.anc3 + ',') < 0 : indexof(collapsedIds, ',' + datum.anc3 + ',') >= 0)) || (isValid(datum.anc4) && ((datum.rawDepth - 5) >= defaultCollapseDepth ? indexof(expandedIds, ',' + datum.anc4 + ',') < 0 : indexof(collapsedIds, ',' + datum.anc4 + ',') >= 0)))
(datum.rawDepth >= stackMinDepth && datum.parentReportCount > gridThreshold && datum.reportCount === 0 && isValid(datum.lag2Id)) ? datum.lag2Id : datum.parentId

(zoomLevel || panX || panY || 1) ? ('M' + datum.source.centerX + ',' + datum.source.cardBottom + 'V' + round((datum.source.cardBottom + datum.target.cardTop) / 2) + 'H' + datum.target.centerX + 'V' + datum.target.cardTop) : ''

path.signal: (zoomLevel || panX || panY || 1) ? ('M' + datum.source.centerX + ',' + datum.source.cardBottom + 'V' + round((datum.source.cardBottom + datum.target.cardTop) / 2) + 'H' + datum.target.centerX + 'V' + datum.target.cardTop) : ''

stroke.test: hoveredId && ((datum.source.id === hoveredId || indexof(hoveredAncPath, ',' + datum.source.id + ',') >= 0 || indexof(datum.source.ancPath, ',' + hoveredId + ',') >= 0) && (datum.target.id === hoveredId || indexof(hoveredAncPath, ',' + datum.target.id + ',') >= 0 || indexof(datum.target.ancPath, ',' + hoveredId + ',') >= 0))

strokeWidth.test: hoveredId && ((datum.source.id === hoveredId || indexof(hoveredAncPath, ',' + datum.source.id + ',') >= 0 || indexof(datum.source.ancPath, ',' + hoveredId + ',') >= 0) && (datum.target.id === hoveredId || indexof(hoveredAncPath, ',' + datum.target.id + ',') >= 0 || indexof(datum.target.ancPath, ',' + hoveredId + ',') >= 0))

opacity.test: !hoveredId || ((datum.source.id === hoveredId || indexof(hoveredAncPath, ',' + datum.source.id + ',') >= 0 || indexof(datum.source.ancPath, ',' + hoveredId + ',') >= 0) && (datum.target.id === hoveredId || indexof(hoveredAncPath, ',' + datum.target.id + ',') >= 0 || indexof(datum.target.ancPath, ',' + hoveredId + ',') >= 0))
!hoveredId || datum.id === hoveredId || indexof(datum.ancPath, ',' + hoveredId + ',') >= 0 || indexof(hoveredAncPath, ',' + datum.id + ',') >= 0

tooltip.signal: {'Employee': datum.Name_clean, 'Title': datum.Title_clean, 'ID': datum.id, 'Direct Reports': datum.reportCount, 'Org Level': datum.rawDepth, 'Status': datum.isCollapsed ? 'Collapsed' : 'Expanded'}
